title: Doc space manifest
description: docspace.yaml in a Doc space's directory (<repo>/<slug>/docspace.yaml), kept by the Doc space's team. Only the copy on the Content repo's main line counts. Fields are only ever added.

slug.description: The Doc space's address segment, docs.wso2.com/<slug>/. Also the name of its directory.

displayName.description: The name readers see, as wso2.com names the product.

formerNames.description: Earlier names, kept searchable (Asgardeo, Bijira, Choreo, Devant).

brand.description: The Cloud brand where it differs from the name (WSO2 Cloud), shown as "Cloud (<brand>)".

cloud.description: The Cloud Edition's name, for example "Identity Platform Cloud".

selfHosted.description: A Self-hosted Edition's name; {version} is filled in, for example "Identity Server {version}".

model.description: Optional: the compose step works it out from the Editions. If given, it must agree with them.

editions.description: The Editions in display order (newest first; never sorted). Cloud, if any, is listed first.

legacyVersions.description: Self-hosted versions not on WSO2 Docs yet: listed under "Older versions (old site)", opening their old site.

latest.description: The Edition built as /latest/. Defaults to the first Self-hosted Edition (the newest release), or Cloud in a Cloud-only Doc space.

home.description: The home Docs section (navigation/sections/<id>.yaml), which must list this Doc space.

listed.description: false for an Unlisted Doc space: no home section, and no section may list it.

indexed.description: With listed: false only: an explicit exception to the Unlisted rule (Contribute). The Doc space stays in no products menu or Docs section, but search engines index it and the sitemap index lists it.

cloud.description: This Doc space's Cloud content is a Cloud part of a family-level Doc space's Cloud tree.

team.description: The owning team, alerted when compose fails because of this file.

repo.description: The Content repo this Doc space lives in.

audienceGroups.description: Audience groups, such as developers and platform-engineers: the only top-level folders of docs/, each holding the skeleton folders. Labels and order come from each folder's _category_.yml. There is no role switch.

environments.description: Only these environments publish the Doc space (the Sandbox: staging only). Default: every environment.

status.description: Not on WSO2 Docs yet: listed with its old site (legacyUrl), with no Docs deployment; docs: links to it fail the build.

version.description: An exact version (1.0.0, not v1.0.0 or 1.0) or a date version (2026.09.24).

id.description: cloud, or an exact or date version.

branch.description: The branch whose newest Docs release tag is deployed. Default: main for Cloud, <slug>/release/<version> in a repo with several Doc spaces, else release/<version>.

pin.description: Holds this Edition on one Docs release tag: releases of its other tags are refused until the pin is removed.

parts.description: On the Cloud Edition only: the component Doc spaces built into this Cloud tree as Cloud parts, from the same Content repo.

notice.description: A banner the chrome shows at runtime from the Deployment manifest (no rebuild).

editions.description: The Editions it applies to. Default: every Edition.
